name: WPKoders PDF Invoice Lite for WooCommerce
author: WPKoders

sections.description:
PDF Invoice Lite gives every WooCommerce order a clean, branded invoice your customers can open and print or Save as PDF straight from their browser — no setup beyond adding your logo and company details. Store managers get a one-click invoice button on the order screen; customers get an invoice link in their account, on the order-received page, and in their order emails.

PDF Invoice Lite shows your customers a clean, branded invoice on screen — ready to print or save as PDF from any browser. Pro generates real downloadable .pdf files that auto-attach to WooCommerce order emails, bulk-export from the orders list, and support multiple branded templates plus packing slips and credit notes.

What you get in Lite

  • A branded, print-ready invoice for every order (print or Save as PDF from any browser).
  • Your branding: company name, address, email, logo, and accent color.
  • A “Save as PDF” button on the order screen for store managers.
  • An “Invoice” link for customers in My Account, on the order-received page, and in order emails.
  • Correct currency and totals using your WooCommerce settings.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart & Checkout Blocks.

PDF Invoice Lite vs Pro

Lite shows the invoice on screen — print or Save as PDF. PDF Invoice Pro turns it into real PDF files, automated:

  • Real downloadable .pdf files generated on your server.
  • Auto-attach invoice PDFs to WooCommerce order emails.
  • Packing slips and credit notes, not just invoices.
  • Bulk-export PDFs as a ZIP from the orders list.
  • Multiple branded templates and advanced layouts.
  • Auto-generate documents on order status changes.

Upgrade to PDF Invoice Pro →

Built by WPKoders, a WooCommerce Marketplace vendor. No tracking, no calls home, no account required.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services and does not send any data off your site.

The only external links in the plugin are outbound links you can choose to click:

  • The Pro version product page on the WooCommerce Marketplace (https://woocommerce.com/products/pdf-invoice).
  • The WPKoders vendor page (https://woocommerce.com/vendor/wpkoders/).

Privacy Policy

PDF Invoice Lite does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. Invoices are generated on demand from your existing WooCommerce order data and your branding settings, which are stored locally in your WordPress database. The plugin does not use cookies, does not include analytics, and does not call home.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “PDF Invoice Lite”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the pdf-invoice-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.

Setup

  1. Go to WooCommerce → PDF Invoice.
  2. Add your company name, address, email, logo, and accent color.
  3. Open any order and click Save as PDF, or let customers view their invoice from My Account.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. If WooCommerce is not active you’ll see an admin notice, and the invoice features load only when WooCommerce is present.

What’s the difference between Lite and Pro?

Lite shows your customers a clean, branded invoice on screen — ready to print or save as PDF from any browser. Pro generates real downloadable .pdf files that auto-attach to WooCommerce order emails, bulk-export from the orders list, and support multiple branded templates plus packing slips and credit notes. See PDF Invoice Pro.

Can I get a real downloadable PDF file?

Lite produces the invoice as an on-screen, print-ready page — use your browser’s “Save as PDF” to download it. Server-generated .pdf files are a Pro feature.

Can invoices attach to order emails automatically?

Lite adds a link to the invoice in customer order emails. Automatically attaching the PDF file to emails is a Pro feature.

Does it create packing slips or credit notes?

Lite focuses on the order invoice. Packing slips and credit notes are a Pro feature.

Will the printed invoice include my theme header and footer?

No. The invoice opens as its own standalone page, so printing or saving as PDF produces just the invoice — no site navigation or other page clutter.
